response.sql:
SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes AS t
JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM telescopes AS eligible
  WHERE eligible.observstation = t.observstation
    AND eligible.equipstatus IS NOT NULL
    AND eligible.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance'
)
GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Count all telescopes at a qualifying station, including those whose equipment status is missing or 'Maintenance'; the status condition qualifies the station, as phrased.
